entries.title: Joni Ernst Announces She’s Not Running for Another Term
entries.summary: The Iowa lawmaker made it official: She’s retiring from the Senate.
entries.content:
Iowa Republican Sen. Joni Ernst will not seek another term in the Senate, she announced in a video posted Tuesday to X.

“It has been an honor to dedicate my life to the service of our great state and country,” Ernst said. “Having been raised in a family who has given me so much love and support, now, as our family ages and grows, it’s my time to give back to them.”

News of Ernst’s incoming announcement came out on Friday, kicking off a race for a Republican seat that has gained some potential with Democrats in recent months. There’s already a crowded Democratic primary field, including Nathan Sage, state Rep. Josh Turek and state Sen. Zach Wahls.
entries.author: Helen Huiskes
